name: wrong-selector
description: Negative control. The harness must fail loudly when a scenario names a control the app does not have, instead of passing on a stale or empty tree. `scripts/test_or_ui.py` asserts that this file reports FAIL with the `not_found` status, so a harness that silently passes an unresolvable selector cannot land. Run it with: python3 scripts/or_ui.py run scripts/ui_scenarios/wrong-selector.json
